title: Contact
description: Request a bid or prequalification from Neil Smith Construction Ltd. in Richmond, BC: what to send, office hours, locations and response time.

hero.title: Contact NSC.
hero.subtitle: Send drawings, a tender package or a prequalification request. Call 604-644-5884 or email info@nscltd.ca.

blocks.title: What to send for a bid.

items.title: Tender documents
items.text: Drawings, specifications, the tender form and any geotechnical reports, emailed to info@nscltd.ca.

items.title: Closing date
items.text: Put the closing date in the subject line, and send any addenda to the same address.

items.title: Prequalification forms
items.text: Ask for our safety program documentation, COR certificate and prequalification package.

items.a: Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. Call 604-644-5884 or email info@nscltd.ca.

items.q: How quickly do you respond to a bid request?
items.a: Our estimating team responds within one business day of receiving a tender package or bid request.
Our head office is at #206-6011 Westminster Hwy in Richmond, and our yard is at 22617 Fraser Hwy in Langley. We work across [Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley](areas/index.html).

items.q: What work do you bid on?
items.a: Excavation and earthworks, underground utilities, site servicing, roads and concrete, stormwater and civil works packages, as prime contractor or civil subcontractor. See our [services](services.html) and [projects](projects/index.html).

items.q: Who do I contact about safety?
items.a: Email safety@nscltd.ca. For our COR certification and safety program, see the [safety page](safety.html).

items.q: How do I apply for a job?
items.a: See open positions on the [careers page](careers.html).
